So the TWO seed reads at the otherwise-identical champion config are 0.4158 (seed 42) and 0.4217 (seed 123): a +0.006 init+noise swing -> dd_sup is SEED-SENSITIVE. (2) LIMITER: ALL FIVE compute/optimization lift levers are MAPPED and EXHAUSTED -- epochs WALL-PINNED at 10 (ep10 used 1176/1200s; ep11 BUSTS the 20-min wall), data coverage MAXED (train_n=579 = the ENTIRE Wagner pool, cannot rise), capacity REGRESSED (iter-4 c24/ep10 -> 0.29856, trading epochs to fund 2.25x conv-compute under-trained the bigger net), lr REGRESSED (iter-7 1.5e-4 -> 0.4133), lambda_neg flat (iter-8 0.1 -> 0.4140, the prior-TPE 0.1-best hint did NOT transfer under the corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). The only LIVE axis is the per-init noise floor: with two seed reads spanning 0.006, a THIRD seed is the highest-value remaining move -- it characterizes whether 0.4217 is a lucky-high or the typical level, which directly informs how real the #2-#4 podium gaps are. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 123 -> 7 (fresh, NOT 42 or 123). seed drives BOTH torch.manual_seed (U-Net init) AND the LDCT noise realization (train uses seed, val uses seed+1000), so it is the genuine init+noise-floor read. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr > 0.425 at seed=7, dd_sup is EVEN MORE seed-sensitive than the two-seed span suggested / 0.4217 was not a ceiling (the noise band is wider than +/-0.003) -> the #3 read is a lucky-high tail and the podium gaps to #2 are softer than they look. rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=72, recon_eta=2.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=72, train_n=0, rationale=iter-9 search-20260619-01 UNCONSTRAINED diff-recon -- TUNE THE DPS GUIDANCE GAIN at the CG-DC working point (untried axis; NFE is now at its val_n budget floor). ONE KNOB: recon_eta (DPS soft-guidance gain, the adaptive-weight scalar zeta_t=eta/||resid|| in Chung 2023 eq.12) 5.0 -> 2.0. BASE = iter-8 (BEST SSIM 0.8784): recon_sample_steps=72, recon_dc_solver=cg, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=false, val_n=72 ALL UNCHANGED. reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (200 train slices, NO retrain). WHY eta IS THE RIGHT KNOB NOW: the NFE lever (recon_sample_steps) was the SSIM climber across iters 6-8 (CG-DC 0.8241 @T40 -> 0.8711 @T56 -> 0.8784 @T72) but is at DIMINISHING returns (+0.047 then +0.0073) AND at its budget floor -- T=72 already needs val_n=72, and the next NFE step T->90 would push val_n below the ~60 representative-metric floor. eta has NEVER been tuned WITH hard-CG active: iters 1-2 moved eta (30->5) on the PURE-SOFT path (recon_dcstep_every=0) BEFORE the CG-DC A-fix existed, where the soft DPS gradient was the ONLY data-fidelity term. Since iter-6 the CG projection (n_cg=3 Gauss-Newton solve of AtA x = At y every 5 steps, relax=1.0 full hard projection) is the DOMINANT fidelity backstop, so the eta=5 soft gradient -- a leftover sized for the no-CG regime -- is likely OVER-DRIVING and double-counting the measurements, fighting the CG projection and leaving residual texture that costs SSIM. eta is a free scalar on the existing per-step gradient: ZERO extra forward/backward/projector calls, so val_n stays 72 (no NFE trade). TRAJECTORY (val L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV, LD-FBP floor 0.8078): iter-1 T25/eta30/every0 0.3688; iter-2 eta30->5 0.3960 (best soft); iter-3 T25->32 0.3869; iter-4 every0->5 LEGACY hard-DC 0.0553 (collapse); iter-5 T->40 soft 0.3709; iter-6 recon_dc_solver=cg CG-DC 0.8241/PSNR27.15 (A-fix); iter-7 T40->56 0.8711/PSNR29.82; iter-8 T56->72 0.8784/PSNR30.59 (BEST). LIMITER: hr regime-bounded at 0 on DENSE 2304-view rebinned Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete); NFE at the val_n budget floor; the eta/guidance gain is the last untried in-budget SSIM axis at the CG-DC working point. HYPOTHESIS: with hard-CG now owning data fidelity, the eta=5 soft DPS gradient is too aggressive and double-counts the measurements; lowering eta 5->2 lets the CG projection dominate and the soft term only nudge, reducing residual texture and lifting SSIM modestly above iter-8 0.8784 -- predicted 0.878-0.885, hr STAYS 0 (regime-bound). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.8784 (flat-or-down vs iter-8) at eta=2, the eta/guidance lever is EXHAUSTED on the CG-DC path (eta inert once hard-CG is active) AND NFE is at its budget floor -> both in-budget SSIM levers are spent; file it, unconstrained best stays iter-8 (SSIM 0.8784, hr 0), and the only remaining lever is the DEFERRED v5 EMA DDPM prior retrain (full train pool + EMA + DPS-recon selection). BUDGET (HARD 20-min=1200s wall, val=72 evenly-spaced L277): eta adds ZERO compute -- iter-8 ran 1051.6s at T=72/val_n=72 = 14.605 s/slice; iter-9 same T=72/val_n=72 -> 72*14.605 = 1052s = 17.5 min < 1200s (~148s headroom). val_n=72 held above the ~60 floor. HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False), recon_dc_solver=cg. reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (NO retrain).
